buildings.description: Steep A-frame timber cabin: glazed front gable with door, living + kitchenette below, sleeping loft reached by a centre stair, deck.
3-storey stone-and-timber guild: tavern hall with quest board, guild office, upstairs dormitory and library.
8-sided dark-brick tower with a copper cone: brewing floors with green-glowing flasks, spiral stair, observatory top.
Symmetric 2-storey white clapboard house: columned portico, black shutters, slate gable, twin chimneys, picket fence.
Single-storey steel diner: counter with stools, booth tables, kitchen, striped awning, big neon roof sign.

6-storey mosaic-tile walk-up: arcade with convenience store + breakfast shop, 10 one-bedroom flats (2 per floor), central U-stair, grilled windows, balconies with laundry, rooftop iron-sheet addition with water tanks.
5F walk-up: G/F ramen shop with counter seating, 2F-4F one-bedroom flats with balcony, 5F loft studio, roof terrace with water tank. Shared U-stair core.
8-storey concrete megablock: market hall, apartments with planted balconies, roof forest and solar canopy.
Single-storey steel garage: two service bays with roller doors and cars on stands, workbenches, tyre stacks.
5-storey hostel: lobby + bar, dorm floors with bunks, private rooms, roof terrace.
Cream-brick 2-storey bakery: bread display, oven, café table, striped awning; baker's flat upstairs.
Single-storey stone villa with a steep thatch hip roof and deep eaves, living / bedroom / outdoor-feel spa bath, palms.
Granite neoclassical bank on a podium: columned portico with pediment, banking hall with teller counter, vault/server room, offices upstairs.
Crisp white cubic 2-storey house: ribbon windows, flat roof terrace, cantilever entrance canopy, red accent panel.
Grey-brick courtyard house front range: red lacquered gate, lanterns, stone lions, slate gable, living rooms behind.
2-storey mosaic shop: bento counter with dining tables, kitchen behind, owner's flat upstairs.
Stone forge with half-timber gable: furnace, anvil, workbench and an open front for customers.
3-storey brick bookshop: G/F bookstacks, 2F café with counter and tables, 3F reading loft flat, green awning.
Restored 1930s red-brick house: café downstairs, gallery loft upstairs, arched windows, potted plants.
3-storey white-tiled walk-up with a bubble-tea counter shop and flats above.

Raised concrete podium, timber post-and-beam café with full glazing, 20ft black container kitchen, outdoor stair to a planted terrace, 40ft yellow container lounge with sliding glass wall, timber canopy roof.
2-storey log lodge: lobby with stone fireplace and restaurant, guest rooms above, deep timber gable.

Stone quay platform in the water with a teal 5-storey and an ochre 6-storey tower sharing one U-stair; G/F grocery + noodle bar, flats above, roof terrace, lanterns, jetty with two rowing boats, boardwalk to shore.
Concrete 2-storey house whose upper floor projects into a 4.5 m cantilevered terrace with glass rail.
7-storey slim capsule hotel: lobby, floors of stacked bunk capsules + lounges, roof terrace, neon blade sign.
4-storey square stone keep with corner turrets: great hall, armoury/storage, lord's chamber + library, crenellated roof walk with banners.
4-storey red-brick walk-up with black steel fire-escape balconies, cornice, one flat per floor.
2-storey black nightclub: dance floor + bar, VIP lounge upstairs, neon bands, queue rope.
Windowless white insulated-panel plant: freezer storage halls, control office, roof chillers.
Introverted fair-faced concrete 2-storey house: few deep windows, minimal interior, flat roof, single maple tree.
3-storey stack clad in blue / yellow / grey corrugated container steel, plywood interiors, roof terrace.
3-storey white-tile pharmacy with shelves and counter, green cross sign, flats above.
4-storey brick-and-glass co-working building: café lobby, hot-desk floors, meeting pods, roof terrace.
2-storey brick brewhouse: taproom bar downstairs, brewing floor above, row of stainless fermentation tanks outside.
3-storey grimy teal clinic: neon-lit surgery bay with exam beds, server room, cramped quarters.
Windowless steel data hall: server rooms with rack rows and consoles, NOC office, roof chillers, backup generators.
2-storey cream palace under a golden onion-style dome with twin minarets: throne hall, banquet, chambers and library.
3-storey steel hub: parcel storage and control room, roof landing pads with delivery drones.
Tall narrow 4-storey brick canal house with a steep stepped gable, white sash windows and a hoist beam.
Squat granite hall with a heavy round door, runic lanterns, forge and anvil inside, low stone roof.
5-storey timber-clad eco block: every flat has a planted balcony with trailing greenery, roof garden with trees and solar.
Sandstone temple: battered pylon gateway, columned portico, sanctuary hall with altar, obelisk.
3-storey pink-tile electronics store: TV walls and gadget shelves, neon sign, storeroom and flat above.
2-storey whitewashed cottage with a thick thatch gable, flower boxes, picket fence and garden path.
2-storey black venue: tall ground floor of gaming PC rows and a stage, lounge & bar upstairs, LED facade.
Lounge kiosk with café and shelves, solar canopy over six fast chargers with parked EVs.
4-storey self-built stack: every floor a different colour, rebar on the roof, AC units, tangled cables.
Brick 2-storey station: double apparatus bay with two ladder trucks behind roller doors, hose tower, upstairs dorm + lounge.
White clapboard 2-storey flower shop: plant-filled shop floor, flower stands on the pavement, green awning, flat above with flower boxes.
2-storey black game centre: rows of arcade cabinets, claw machines, upstairs arcade + bar, neon signage.
Convenience kiosk with shelves and counter, big illuminated canopy over four pumps, price pylon.
3-storey Fachwerk: stone shop floor, half-timbered upper floors, steep red tile roof, flower boxes.
Gingerbread-brick cottage with icing trim, candy-cane posts and giant lollipops; pink frosting roof.
4-storey dark glass cube: lobby + café, open-plan offices and meeting rooms, roof terrace with solar canopy.
3-storey black-brick manor: tall lancet windows, steep slate mansard with dormers, iron spike fence, red-lit windows.
Timber 2-storey house with a sedum-planted shed roof, big south glazing and planters.
Single-storey white-framed glasshouse with a glass gable roof: café counter, tables among potted palms and ferns.
Single-storey hanok converted to a café: curved tile roof, timber posts, café tables inside.
Low dark hall of glowing fish tanks and benches under a big glass dome.
Decaying 2-storey timber house: boarded-up windows, rusted tin gable, creaky interior, cold blue light upstairs.
3-storey tiled teahouse: banquet dining halls on every floor, kitchen, red/gold signage, lanterns.
6-storey mosaic tenement: cha chaan teng diner, caged balconies, AC units, neon blade sign, laundry, rooftop.
Home dug into a grassy mound: round green door, round windows, cosy living room, pantry and bedroom.
3-storey tiled hospital: lobby + triage clinics, wards with beds, exam rooms, roof terrace, drop-off canopy, ambulance, red cross.
6-storey Art Deco hotel: black-marble lobby with reception + bar, restaurant, 24 guest rooms, brass-trimmed stepped crown, vertical fins.

Stone plinth, dark timber G/F with living/kitchen/bath, half-timbered plaster upper floor with tatami room and bedroom, blue slate hip roofs with upturned corners, covered balcony + outside stair, garden with lantern.
Teal clapboard 2-storey teahouse on a raised timber deck around an old tree trunk; red-framed bay windows, paper lanterns, roof terrace with antennas.
Single-storey steel-and-glass terminal hall with ticket lobby, behind it a transparent hyperloop tube with a waiting pod.
Single-storey black timber house with a grass-covered gable roof, stone chimney, living room and bed nook.
2-storey pub with a dark green timber shopfront, gold lettering, hanging baskets; bar downstairs, function room upstairs.
Timber-fronted izakaya: counter bar with stools, tables, kitchen, red lanterns and noren; small flat above; slate gable.
3-storey white tenshu on a 3 m battered stone base: tiered curled roofs at every floor, golden shachihoko, samurai hall inside.
Classic 2-storey Japanese suburban house: white siding, sliding windows, slate hip roof, small balcony, AC units.
2-storey ryokan: lobby and indoor hot-spring bath, tatami guest rooms upstairs, lanterns, curled slate roof.
Tiny single-storey tea room: tatami, low table, slate hip roof, stepping-stone garden with bamboo fence.
4-storey black KTV: G/F bar, private karaoke lounges on upper floors (sofa + TV), neon floor bands, vertical blade sign.
Single-storey cheerful kindergarten: classroom + play lounge, red tile gable, playground with slide, swings and sandbox.
2-storey stone barracks with crenellated roof walk and banners: mess hall, armoury, bunk rooms, training yard with dummies.
Single-storey hanok on a stone plinth: timber posts, raised wooden maru veranda, paper sliding doors, curved tiled hip roof.
4-storey cream brick: 24h convenience store, tiny gosiwon study rooms above, rooftop.
Narrow timber townhouse: G/F sweets shop with noren curtain and lanterns, tatami living above, sliding lattice windows, slate gable.
8-sided vermilion tower hung with dozens of red lanterns, tile cone roof, spiral stair to a lookout.
Narrow 3-storey mosaic block: G/F coin laundry with washer wall and bench, two small flats above.
Massive exposed-concrete library: tall reading hall of stacks, upper reading room + meeting room, deep concrete fins and slab crown.
Red/white striped 5-storey round tower with spiral stair, gallery deck, glazed lantern room with glowing lens; keeper's cottage.
3-storey townhouse clad in blue azulejo tiles, wrought-iron balconies, red tile gable.
Single tall steel warehouse: racking aisles, three roller loading docks, delivery trucks in the yard.
3-storey cream château with slate mansard + dormers and two conical corner turrets, grand salon and bedrooms.
Red-brick 3-storey Victorian terrace: bay window, black front door with fanlight, slate gable roof, chimney stacks.
2-storey black-and-gold casino: gaming floor of machines, bar and lounge, upstairs VIP room, huge neon marquee.
3-storey stone academy: lecture halls, grand library, slate gable, twin conical towers flanking the front.
Raised 2-storey white beach house: full-height glass, wraparound balcony, shed roof, surfboards.
3-storey manga café: G/F manga library, PC booth floors above, neon sign.
Nine-tier stepped stone pyramid with a central stair to a summit temple room (altar, torches).
Whitewashed 2-storey house with blue door and shutters, terracotta hip roof, balcony, bougainvillea boxes.
Stone-and-timber tavern: great hearth, bar, kitchen; half-timbered guest rooms upstairs; slate roof, hanging sign, ale barrels, well.
2-storey saturated red casa with blue door, roof terrace strung with papel picado bunting.
Low single-storey timber house with floor-to-ceiling glass, butterfly-flat shed roof with deep eaves, stone chimney, carport.
Pure white 2-storey box with a few large picture windows, flush door, roof terrace.
Red-brick U-shaped courtyard house: ancestral hall in the centre, bedrooms in two wings, curled tile roofs, cobbled courtyard.
16-sided felt ger with a low cone roof: stove, beds and rugs around a central hearth.
Ochre 2-storey riad: carved arch door, mashrabiya grilles, tiled lounge, guest rooms, roof terrace with lanterns.
Tin-roofed open-front food hall with tables, five neon food stalls on the street, lanterns.
3-storey Creole townhouse wrapped in lacy cast-iron galleries, tall shuttered French doors, jazz bar downstairs.
Single-storey black-timber cabin with a steep slate gable, big picture window, fireplace, firewood stack.
Narrow 4-storey brownstone with raised stoop, double timber door, cornice, sash windows, flat roof with water tank.
12-sided white drum: visitor/lab floor, control room, telescope floor under a copper dome with an opening slit and a large telescope.

20x20 m, 10 floors: marble lobby + reception, 2 elevator shafts (car objects with level data) + fire stair, open-plan offices / meeting / pantry / server room, 5 vacant shell floors for custom fit-out, executive suite, roof with helipad and plant.
2-storey black parlor: rows of machines (arcade cabinets), bar upstairs, giant neon 777 sign.
Cream stone 4-storey block: corner café with terrace, wrought-iron balconies, mansard slate roof with dormers, cornice.
5-storey open concrete car park with parked cars on every deck, stair core, big P sign.
2-storey tarred-timber tavern: rum bar and tables, rooms upstairs, ship's-wheel sign, rope festoons, barrels.
6-storey white panel block with glass pod balconies on every flat, solar roof terrace.

Raised copper module house: pipe-frame base + deck, lower glazed kitchen/lab pod, interior stair to an upper sleeping module with wrap balcony, roof hatch, two large tilting solar panels, antenna mast, hydroponic planters.
Concrete 2-storey precinct: public lobby with front desk, squad office, holding/storage, upstairs open office, briefing room, server room.
Single-storey cream-brick post office: counter hall with rope queue, parcel storage, green post box, flag.
Crooked 2-storey half-timbered apothecary: glowing potion displays outside and in, alchemist's flat upstairs.
Steel-clad sawtooth hall full of treadmills and weight benches, glass front, neon sign.
Single-storey printed concrete drum with a smooth dome roof, round windows, sleeping and living niches.
3-storey sandstone haveli: carved jharokha screens, courtyard-style rooms, roof terrace with domed chhatri pavilions.
Big red gambrel barn: tractor/garage bay and workshop with roller door, hay loft above, steel grain silo.
Log izba with carved teal window surrounds and shutters, steep plank gable, stove and bed inside.
Whitewashed cubic 2-storey house with a blue dome, blue doors and shutters, roof terrace edge.
3-storey brick school: classrooms with desks/whiteboards on every floor, library, front-yard basketball court, flagpole, clock.
2-storey concrete museum with a glazed sawtooth roof: exhibit halls of consoles and models, library and meeting room.
2-storey granite house with slate gable and twin end chimneys, deep-set windows, cosy hearth.
Two-storey motel strip: office/lobby, rows of guest rooms each with its own balcony walkway, neon MOTEL sign, parking.
3-storey Victorian with teal clapboard, white trim, bay window, steep front gable, stoop.
3-storey pastel Peranakan shophouse: five-foot-way arcade, louvred shutters, tile gable, shop below, family above.
3-storey grey-brick shikumen with a carved stone door frame, black double doors, slate gable, lane-house plan.
Single-storey timber sheriff's office with false front, desk and a barred cell.
Vermilion shrine hall on a stone plinth with sliding paper doors and a curved slate gable; torii gate, stone lanterns, offering box, bell, sacred tree.

Corner shop with open frontage (raised roller shutters) on two streets: record & game corner, snack counter, shelves, arcade. Upper blue flat with wrap balcony and LED under-glow, rooftop garden with palms.
2-storey net-zero house: whole shed roof is a solar array, heat-pump unit, light timber cladding.
16-sided habitat ring under a big glass dome: hydroponic farm racks, crew lounge, consoles; airlock entrance.
Long single-storey stucco ranch house with arched veranda, terracotta roof, living/dining/kitchen/bedrooms.
2-storey white stucco house with a ground-floor arcade, iron balconies, terracotta hip roof.
3-storey dark-glass office: lobby café, open-plan desks, meeting rooms, server room, roof terrace.

Four containers (blue 20ft bunks, yellow 40ft lab, grey 20ft mess, grey 40ft comms/lounge) on stilts around a glass stair tower; twin front stairs, upper balcony walkway + slanted canopy, antenna mast, dish, fuel drums.
3-storey copper-and-brick workshop: machine shop, drafting library, inventor's loft; giant brass gears, steam pipes, smokestacks, airship mooring mast.
Stone nave with tall lancet windows, rows of pews and altar, steep slate gable, square bell tower with brass bell and spire.
3-storey creator building: street-level set, editing suites and a loft flat, pink neon.
Large steel-clad supermarket: aisles of double shelves, wall of drink fridges, checkout counters, carts, front parking.
2-storey falu-red timber cottage with white corner boards and frames, slate gable, porch.
Stone base + log upper storey, wide low gable with deep eaves, wrap balcony with flower boxes, red shutters.
Vermilion hall on a tall stone plinth with sweeping curled roof and ornaments, altar inside, censer and bagua courtyard.

Stone podium with front stair, 3-storey timber pavilion (altar hall / scripture library / lookout) linked by interior stairs, verandas with red columns, triple curled hip roofs, neon-lit paifang gate and red lantern strings.
Teak house raised 2 m on a plinth with front stair and porch, steep tile gable, open-plan living + bedroom.
Three hide tipis around a stone-ringed campfire, drying rack and log seats.
Cedar plank longhouse with a low gable, painted façade band and two carved totem poles: great room with hearth and sleeping platforms.

6x7 m five-storey neon tower: G/F DVD & gadget shop, 2F hacker den with servers, 3F capsule hostel, 4F neon bar, 5F loft, roof hut with antennas. Grimy steel cladding, fans, pipes, vertical neon signs.
Giant oak with a wrap deck at 4.5 m reached by a timber stair, a gabled cabin (bed, desk, lantern) and a rope ladder to a crow's-nest lookout.
Stone ground-floor pub with bar and booths, half-timbered upper floor of guest rooms, steep tile gable, lanterns, hanging sign.
Stone 2-storey casale with a low terracotta hip roof, green shutters, cypress trees, rustic kitchen.
Red temple hall on a stone plinth: dragon-wrapped columns, swallow-tail curled roof with ornaments, altar inside, incense burner.
Narrow 4-storey mosaic townhouse: G/F garage with roller door, family floors above, roof terrace with water tank.
5-storey glass tower of LED-lit hydroponic racks, shop for produce, solar roof.
Long single-storey timber hall with a steep shingled roof and carved dragon-head gable ends: feast hall, hearth, sleeping benches.

Glass-walled concrete living pavilion (living/dining/kitchen island), floating stair, cantilevered upper volume with master suite + ensuite, 2nd bedroom, study, garage with car, roof terrace, infinity pool & deck.

Charcoal composite villa with cyan circuit-trace lighting: gated courtyard, glowing steps, G/F lounge + kitchen + game room, 2F suite with balcony, west wing with roof terrace reached by an outside stair.
5-storey 5.6 m-wide tube house: ground-floor cà phê, one room per floor, plant balconies, roof terrace.
Converted brick warehouse: G/F workshop and garage bay with roller door, two double-height studio lofts above, sawtooth glazed roof.
2-storey timber saloon with false front, swinging doors, bar, card tables, rooms upstairs off a wooden balcony.
8-sided brick windmill: grain store, millstone floor with reefing gallery, miller's loft; timber cap with four lattice sails (rotate prop).
Tiny dark timber cottage with a needle-steep roof, crooked chimney, bubbling green cauldron, herb shelves.
12-sided stone tower: library, alchemy lab, bedchamber and star-gazing study linked by a spiral stair; tall blue cone roof, glowing crystals.
2-storey timber-and-plaster inn: tavern hall of tables and a bar, guest rooms above, curled slate roof, banner pole.

env.description: Island terrain + streets + lamps + trees that hosts every TownKit building.
